mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '采购 / 销售订单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_supplier_price WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '供货价格' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_requisition_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '请购单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_inquiry_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '询价单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_quotation_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '销售报价单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_price_list WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '销售价目表' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN '采购 / 销售订单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_delivery WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN '发货通知' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '采购 / 销售订单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '出入库单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_requisition WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '请购单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_quotation WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '销售报价单' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_quotation WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN '销售报价单' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN '采购 / 销售订单' END
